notes.title: Bridge! 2 Update V 1.0.3
notes.content: The update V 1.0.3 for [b]Bridge! 2[/b] involves a very important change. The black screen crashes at non-native resolution in full screen mode have been fixed and ​​various performance optimisations were made - thus as of now building bridges run more smoothly!

notes.title: Bridge! 2 Update V 1.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Bridge! 2[/b] now also on Linux! In addition to the Linux version a new camera rotation has been added that allows the players to watch their building, depending on the zoom, also from below and above. Further the camera is following the mouse if it gets to the side of the screen now. Last but not least the text of tutorial 1 has been changed and the terrains of the city harbor sceneries has been adapted for a better under water representation.

[b]Changelog[/b]
[list]
[*]Linux version added. Please be aware that this release is considered as "experimental" because we had only very view test machines. If you encounter bigger problems please report them in the Steam forums. Thanks in advance!
[*]Camera rotation has been added and the corresponding text in the first tutorial reworked. The cam can be rotated by pressing and holding the middle mouse button. The degrees are zoom dependent to prevent looks behind the scene borders.
[*]Camera pans now when you move the cursor to the viewport borders. The corresponding text in the first tutorial covers this now too.
[*]Terrains of the city harbor scenarios have been reworked to fix the underwater ground issues especially when the water quality is set to simple.
[/list]

Camera pans now when you move the cursor to the viewport borders.

notes.title: Bridge! 2 Update
notes.content:
The first [b]Bridge! 2[/b] Update is available now! The new version includes a revised Mission description of tutorial 8 as well as an optimized Menu backgrounds for a better readability. The Boxbeam raildeck separation joint gets properly unlocked for the editor and is available for everyone who solved the mission "Railway bascule bridge". Also a VSync option is added to the options menu.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[list][*]Boxbeam raildeck separation joint gets properly unlocked for the editor and is available for everyone who solved the mission "Railway bascule bridge"
[*]Mission description of tutorial 8 has been updated because some users complained that it is not clear enough how the decks have to be built.
[*]Typo in mission description of mission "Footing and crossbeams" has been fixed 
[*]Version number is now shown in the main menu 
[*]Menu backgrounds are less transparent now for a better readability 
[*]VSync option added to the options menu
[/list]
